title: ISO 16431:2012 — Hydraulic fluid power — System clean-up procedures and verification of cleanliness of assembled systems
version: ISO 16431:2012, Edition 1; reviewed and confirmed in 2022
locator: Official abstract: methods to measure fluid cleanliness in an assembled hydraulic system, verify required cleanliness at production release and clean the system when required.
notes: System clean-up and cleanliness-verification method; the official description states that it is not intended to replace ISO 23309 system flushing. Do not infer a universal cleanliness target from the method.
